description: Build, run and analyze aerosol simulations; report concerns; develop, test and document Particula with illustrated examples.

defaultPrompt: Help me install Particula and check my local Python environment.
Build and run a small condensation simulation, then plot and explain the results.
Debug my Particula script and check its units, conservation, and time-step sensitivity.
interface.longDescription: Seven researcher workflows for setup, guidance, simulation design, execution, analysis, debugging and issue reporting, plus six Particula repository skills for planning, development, testing, documentation, illustrated example authoring and review. Uses the selected checkout and environment. Reports require researcher review before posting. No hosted service, automatic Python installation or MCP server is included.

publication.release_notes: Adds researcher issue reporting with investigation and approval before posting, plus published-example authoring with explained code, plots or process visuals, reflections and topic links. Validated plugin version bumps now publish GitHub releases automatically, independently of Python library releases.

name: particula-helper
